thread:
harper: Quick note  I'm opening a small PR to clarify tenant-affinity vs tenant-isolation language in the Dedicated provisioning guide. People keep confusing affinity with reserved pools.

sienna: Nice. Can we add a tiny YAML example that shows `affinityHints` vs `reservedPool` flags so it's clear visually?

harper: Adding this snippet to the runbook:
```yaml
tenantId: team-sapphire
labels:
  - analytics
  - sla:tier-committed
affinityHints:
  preferSameHost: false
  preferReservedPool: true
reservedPool: true
scalePolicy:
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 25
  cooldown: 180
```

omar: Tiny nit: `reservedPool: true` is user-visible but infra treats `preferReservedPool` as a hint. Add a one-line callout: "hint vs guarantee".

harper: Good call  adding a bold callout and an SDK mapping.

kevin: Please include a one-liner JS SDK example too, folks copy that straight into onboarding docs.

harper: JS snippet I'm adding:
```js
await client.dedicated.create({
  tenantId: 'team-sapphire',
  labels: ['analytics','sla:tier-committed'],
  affinityHints: { preferReservedPool: true, preferSameHost: false },
  reservedPool: true,
  scalePolicy: { minReplicas: 2, maxReplicas: 25, cooldown: 180 }
});
```

sienna: Also add an FAQ entry: "What happens if reserved pools are full?" with steps and observable symptoms (quota=exhausted event, fallback to transient).

omar: Add a short troubleshooting checklist: check tenant quota, region capacity, reserved pool assignment, and allocator logs. Maybe include the CLI command to inspect assignment.

harper: Adding CLI example:
```bash
redwoodctl dedicated status --tenant team-sapphire --region eu-west-1 --output json
```

kevin: One more: ensure SLA wording is illustrative only. Change any absolute numbers to "illustrative p95 target" and add link to legal SLA page for enterprise.

sienna: Also recommend a tiny runbook step: "If preemption observed while reservedPool=true, contact SRE; include allocator log snippet and tenant id." That helps customer support.

harper: Added that. Fixed two stale links in the guide (old infra module path and a CLI doc). Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422 - "docs: tenant-affinity vs reserved-pool wording + examples".

docs-bot: PR opened by harper: PR #1422  requested reviewers: sienna, omar. Preview build queued: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-1422

omar: Left a couple inline comments: clarify that `preferSameHost` can be ignored for multi-AZ deployments.

harper: Updated branch to add a short note about multi-AZ behavior. Pushed.

kevin: LGTM pending CI. If anything looks like a promise, flag it here before merge.

sienna: :thumbsup: will do a quick pass after the preview build is up.

harper: Thanks all  merging after 2 approvals + green CI.
